versions.changelog:
- Merge pull request #2 from patello/fix/site-departures-filtered-truncation
- fix: filter line/direction locally to bypass API response cap

- Merge pull request #1 from patello/pr/route-time-timezone-note
- chore: bump version to 3.6.0
- docs: align references/api.md CLI paths to ClawHub-installed layout
- docs: clarify --time/--date are Stockholm local time while route find output is UTC
- v1.1.0: graceful --direction validation, python3 migration, CLI execution docs

- chore: bump version to 3.4.1
- docs: clarify route saving workflow with specific constraints and remove PII
- Enhance route save default syntax, auto-augment first-leg transit lines, and clean up stop name extraction

- Add via, dwell-time, and not-via flags to route find command
- Add SL Transport and SL Deviations API reference specifications
- Add SL Journey Planner v2 Trips API reference specification

- Fix date and time query parameters mapping to itd_date and itd_time in trips requests
- Update documentation in references/api.md and SKILL.md for route save time/date flags
- Consolidate alternative transit lines across travel proposals during route save
- Implement --time and --date flags for route save
- Fix route check departures site ID mismatch and improve route find matching
- Fix UTC/local timezone relative calculation mismatch in route check on UTC servers (v3.0.1)
- Integrate SL Journey Planner v2 for route finder and proposal saving (v3.0.0)

- Enhance route check: localized warnings grouping, departures print, sequential filtering fallback, and direction list matching
- Configure GitHub Action to automatically generate release changelogs from git history

- Adds references/api.md, consolidating all endpoint details, payload formats, and filtering instructions.
- State file path changes to .sl/preferences.json; preference structure updated to favourite_stops and favourite_routes (see api.md for format).
- Now allows on-demand queries for any stop/route without prior registration; favourites are only used for autonomous monitoring.
- Departures and deviations can be fetched for any site/line at any time; autonomous logic strictly filters disruptions as specified in api.md.
- All action specifics (curl usage, jq filtering, input/output formats) are now defined in references/api.md for cleaner documentation.

- Initial release for managing SL (Stockholm public transport) user preferences and deviation alerts.
- Supports searching for site IDs by stop name using efficient jq filtering.
- Allows saving preferences for general monitoring and specific journeys, with clear JSON format and local file storage.
- Fetches and strictly filters real-time/public transport disruptions, only reporting those relevant to user-defined stations, lines, and routes.
- Automation-ready: designed to minimize noise and only alert users about meaningful, new disruptions affecting their chosen commutes.
